attributes.kept_by: Ysoly Tamm — cut at dusk, every dusk, never delegated
attributes.legal_standing: accepted at the rim weighbridges as a book of account under the Compact of Weights
attributes.material: rim-oak, four-sided, about a yard long, black with handling
attributes.vulnerability: one stick, no copy. Split or burned, the caravan's debts and its wages both vanish at once — which is not symmetrical, because the debts are remembered at Bell Harrow and the wages are not remembered anywhere.
attributes.what_it_records: wages owed, water drawn per head, ballast dumped, and the death-share owed to a hand's family

name: Ysoly's Tally-Stick
summary: A yard of rim-oak, four-sided, gone black with thirty years of handling and notched along every face — one face for heads, one for water drawn, one for ballast, one for what is owed and to whom. Ysoly cuts it herself at dusk and nobody else touches it; it is the caravan's only ledger and the only thing on the plain that records what a hand's family is owed if the hand does not come back. The rim weighbridges accept it as good as a book, which means anyone who splits it splits the record.
